description: Source code for the PcbNode class, which represents nodes in a PCB (Printed Circuit Board) data structure, including parsing, serialization, and node management.

classes.name: PcbNode
classes.description: Represents a node in a PCB structure, capable of parsing, serialization, and managing child nodes.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads PCB node data from a file and parses it into a PcbNode object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string content into a PcbNode, constructing the node hierarchy.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the PcbNode and its children into a string format.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the serialized node data to a specified file.

methods.name: setDouble
methods.description: Sets a child node value at a specified index to a double value.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a child node value at a specified index as a double.

methods.name: hasChild
methods.description: Checks if a child node with a given key exists.

methods.name: findIfExists
methods.description: Finds a child node with a given key if it exists, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a unique child node with a given key, throws exception if multiple found.

methods.name: nodes
methods.description: Returns a list of child nodes.

methods.name: iterate
methods.description: Returns a list of child nodes matching a specific key.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of all children.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Returns the child at a specific index as a string.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Sets the value of a child node at a specific index to a string.

methods.name: setInt
methods.description: Sets the value of a child node at a specific index to an integer.
